submitted.rationale: All five EQE measurements are close to zero (|EQE| ≤ 0.002%), which fits wide-gap La antimonates (La3SbO7, LaSbO4) that absorb little or no light at 2.7 eV. Index 12 (Sb 0.257, near the La3SbO7 composition) gave the highest reading, 0.00029%. This value is within the noise of the other readings, so there is no real evidence that it outperforms them.
